geopolitics_summary: EU summer heatwave triggers nuclear outages & Danube drought; Rosatom safety row risks Hungary Paks-II; US gas record supports LNG export capacity.

themes.headline: Romania shuts nuclear reactor as Danube hits record lows
themes.why_it_matters: Loss of thermal generation (nuclear + coal cooling-water constrained) tightens EU generation mix; forces gas-fired backup online. Directly pressures DAM spreads and Q4 power curves via reduced supply.

themes.headline: Hungary uses sunken barges to raise Danube for nuclear plant operation
themes.why_it_matters: Paks nuclear under thermal stress; emergency mitigation indicates extreme margin pressure. Widespread EU summer nuclear derating (France jellyfish, cooling-water) reduces baseload; sustained upward pressure on peak power and gas demand.

themes.headline: Swarming jellyfish overrun French nuclear plant same date two years running
themes.why_it_matters: Pattern-risk for French nuclear availability (record outages this summer). Loss of large baseload blocks pushes EU to higher-cost thermal (coal, gas). Direct impact on DA/ID power prices and gas stack competition through Q4.

themes.headline: US natural gas production forecast to hit record 122.5 Bcf/d in 2026
themes.why_it_matters: US LNG export capacity fully utilized; record production supports LNG flows to EU/NW Europe. Increases supply elasticity on TTF; may cap near-term gas rally despite summer EU nuclear stress. Medium-term TTF weakness risk.

themes.headline: Rosatom safety violations alleged; EU sanctions pressure over Hungary Paks-II link
themes.why_it_matters: Sanctions on Rosatom could delay/halt Hungary Paks-II nuclear project, removing 2.4 GW baseload. Increases reliance on gas for EU power balance through 2030s. Political risk to long-dated power & gas curves.

watchlist: Danube water levels & thermal plant reopening timeline (Romania, Hungary, France).
French nuclear reactor return-to-service schedule (cooling outages, jellyfish-risk dates).
Rosatom sanctions decision / timeline; impact on Paks-II commissioning.
EU demand destruction impact on Q4 power forwards (industrial heat stress economic downturn).
